config.label: Fitbit OAuth client ID
config.description: Fitbit OAuth client ID. Optional when configured with fitbit-mcp-server setup.

config.label: Fitbit OAuth client secret
config.description: Fitbit OAuth client secret. Prefer fitbit-mcp-server setup so this secret is stored in ~/.fitbit-mcp/config.json instead of MCP client config.

config.label: Redirect URI configured in the Fitbit Developer Dashboard
config.description: Redirect URI configured in the Fitbit Developer Dashboard. Optional when configured with fitbit-mcp-server setup.

config.label: Optional local path for OAuth tokens
config.description: Optional local path for OAuth tokens. Defaults to ~/.fitbit-mcp/tokens.json.

config.label: Optional payload mode: summary, structured, or raw
config.description: Optional payload mode: summary, structured, or raw. Defaults to structured. raw means full Fitbit API payloads, not continuous 24/7 raw sensor telemetry.

config.label: Optional SQLite cache toggle
config.description: Optional SQLite cache toggle. Set to true or sqlite to enable.

config.label: Optional local SQLite cache path
config.description: Optional local SQLite cache path. Defaults to ~/.fitbit-mcp/cache.sqlite.

config.label: Set to true to bypass the in-memory HTTP response cache (60s TTL for GET only)
config.description: Set to true to bypass the in-memory HTTP response cache (60s TTL for GET only). POST/PUT/DELETE and 4xx/5xx responses are never cached regardless.
